messages:
ana_marketing: Hey design team — quick visual ops ask for next week's webinar on inference economics :sparkles: 
ana_marketing: Need a compact kit we can repurpose for slides, social, and the registration page. Scope: 1 hero diagram (static + small svg loader), 3 micro-tiles (social sizes), 1 four-frame microstoryboard for IG/Twitter, and 1 swimlane map showing inbound lead routing + handoff to AE. Also a one-page pacing timeline for the webinar host.
ana_marketing: Brand constraints: two approved colorways (light/dark), single headline type scale, include small legal copy area. Please keep file sizes web-friendly. Deadline: first pass by Tue noon PT, final by Wed EOD.
cam_design: Got it. Do you have exact pixel sizes for the micro-tiles and social frames? And any example assets for the hero diagram composition? :eyes:
ana_marketing: Micro-tiles: 1080x1080 (IG), 1200x628 (Twitter), 320x480 (email). Storyboard frames 1080x1080 each. Hero = 1600x900 + svg 120x120 loader. I'll drop a reference figma.
ana_marketing: Figma refs: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/inf-econ-refs (permissions open to "marketing" team). Also copy snippets below.
ryan_growth: Need two messaging variants: paid acquisition CTA and organic/partner CTA. Paid should emphasize "fast predictable latency" + signup CTA. Organic can lean on "cost transparency" + webinar signup.
jia_prod: For the swimlane map, routing details: inbound form -> lead scoring -> AE queue A (premium leads) or AE queue B (self-serve), with fallback to SDRs after 48h. CRM field: "inference_use_case" must be visible. If you need JSON of fields I can paste it.
jia_prod: JSON snippet: `{"lead_source":"webinar","score_threshold":75,"routing":"AE_A|AE_B|SDR"}`
cam_design: Thanks Jia — that helps with the swimlane copy. Any mandatory logos/partner badges to include?
ana_marketing: Only Redwood logo and "Powered by Redwood Inference" lockup. No partner badges this time. Also include small footer: "Data shown for illustrative purposes."
morgan_legal: Quick flag — hero claim language needs signoff. Send me the final headline and any comparative claims. I can turn around review within 24 hours.
ana_marketing: Headline options (pick one or ask for tweaks):
- `Hero A: "Make inference predictable. Make it affordable."`
- `Hero B: "Serve models reliably at cloud scale — lower per‑token cost."`
- `Hero C: "Ship faster, serve cheaper: the inference playbook."`
nana_marketing: Comparative line for slide: "Up to 3x lower per-token cost with caching + batching (typical workloads)." (Morgan — that's the comparative needing review)
design-bot: Uploaded file: figma://inference-econ-kit/1765500000 (preview: https://figma-preview.example/1765500000) :white_check_mark:
cam_design: I'll start layouts tonight. Plan: hero diagram sketch + two colorway comps by Tue 09:00 PT, micro-tiles by Tue noon, storyboard roughs by Tue 15:00. Can we drop the storyboard frames as separate artboards so growth can slice them?
ryan_growth: Yes pls separate frames and label with copy variants for paid vs organic. Also add a version with subtle CTA overlay for paid.
cam_design: Noted. Animation ask: small svg loader for hero — low fps loop, simple token/cost pulse. I can hand off an animated SVG and a GIF fallback.
nana_marketing: Perfect — please tag me on each new commit. Priority order: 1) hero diagram + loader, 2) swimlane routing map, 3) micro-tiles, 4) storyboard, 5) pacing one-pager.
morgan_legal: I'll wait for the hero/comparative copy to review. If you ping me directly I can prioritize.
nana_marketing: Thanks all — cc @ryan_growth for the inbound routing requirements. Any blockers? :calendar:
cam_design: No blockers. Will flag if color contrast or type scale needs legal tweak.
ryan_growth: Can we also get a small 600x200 banner for paid ads? Low priority but handy.
cam_design: Adding to scope.
nana_marketing: Great — talk soon.
